pages.text: Right-click an active heat source with a hot stone, leather warmer or insulated flask. Keep the charged item in your hotbar. Charcoal warmer additionally consumes coal or charcoal from offhand.

pages.title: First protection
pages.text: In heat, first seek shade, remove excess insulation, avoid sprinting and drink. In cold, avoid water and wind, shelter and wear dry clothing. Then craft portable warming or cooling items.
Cool a compatible pack on ice or full snow. Wet cloth uses water in a cauldron; a hand fan works by right-click. Charge decays over time and the strongest item wins, not a sum of all items.
